lines.titulo: Adam and Eve, in the Garden of Eden.
lines.g1: Have you ever really wanted to do something that someone who loves you said not to do?
lines.c1a: God planted a beautiful garden, called Eden.
lines.c1b: It had rivers of cool water, flowers of every color, and trees with delicious fruit.
lines.c2a: God put Adam in the garden to take care of it. And Adam gave a name to every animal:
lines.c2b: the lion, the giraffe, the turtle... What a fun job!
lines.c3a: But Adam still didn't have anyone like him, to talk with and share his life.
lines.c3b: So God made Eve, and Adam was very happy!
lines.c4a: God said, “You may eat from every tree in the garden.
lines.c4b: Just don't eat from this tree here, the tree of the knowledge of good and evil. It will hurt you.”
lines.c5a: One day, a very clever serpent whispered to Eve:
lines.c5b: “God doesn't want you to eat it, because you would become wise like Him.”
lines.c6a: Eve looked at the fruit... took it, ate it, and gave some to Adam, who ate it too.
lines.c6b: Right away, they felt sad and ashamed.
lines.c7a: In the evening, when they heard God walking in the garden, Adam and Eve hid.
lines.c7b: But no one can hide from God.
lines.c8a: Disobeying had consequences: they had to leave the garden.
lines.c8b: But God made warm clothes for them, and kept on taking care of them.
lines.c8c: And He promised that one day, He would send someone to make everything right.
lines.l1: God's rules are like a fence that keeps us safe.
lines.l2: And even when we make mistakes, God never stops loving us.
lines.l3: Talk with your family: what is one rule in your home that keeps you safe?
lines.fim: Subscribe to the channel! Next story: Noah and the Great Ark.
